d: To safely operate heavy vehicles and transport employees, equipment, materials, and tools to project sites while ensuring compliance with traffic regulations, company policies, and safety standards.
q: Valid Bahraini Heavy Vehicle Driving License.
Minimum 3 years of experience operating heavy vehicles, preferably in construction, electrical, or industrial projects.
Good knowledge of Bahrain roads and traffic regulations.
Ability to perform basic vehicle inspections and identify defects.
r: li
Operate heavy vehicles such as trucks, flatbeds, boom trucks, and other assigned transportation vehicles.
li
Transport electrical materials, equipment, tools, and personnel safely to project locations.
li
Conduct daily vehicle inspections and ensure vehicles are in safe operating condition.
li
Perform routine checks on fuel, oil, water, tires, lights, and brakes.
li
Maintain vehicle cleanliness and report any defects, accidents, or maintenance requirements promptly.
li
Ensure proper securing and safe transportation of materials and equipment.
li
Follow assigned schedules and delivery routes to support project operations.
li
Comply with Bahrain traffic laws and company driving policies.
li
Keep accurate records of trips, fuel consumption, and vehicle inspections.
li
Assist with loading and unloading materials when required.
li
Coordinate with Site Supervisors and Logistics personnel regarding transportation requirements.
li
Adhere to all HSE policies, procedures, and site regulations.
